text:
maria: Quick sync — thinking about a "credit exchange" pilot where customers can convert marketplace credits (private offers) into Redwood Dedicated reservation credits during onboarding. Want to sync before I brief field. Any immediate blockers?
suresh: Interesting. Need to check marketplace policy on private offers + credit redemptions. Which marketplaces are we targeting? AWS and Azure to start?
maria: Start with Azure Marketplace and AWS Marketplace (private offers). Azure partner asked for simpler convert path first. GCP is a follow-up.
nana: (typo)
nana: sorry ignore
ana: Actually finance question: how do we value marketplace credits vs reserved commitment? Need a formula before we promise anything.
ana: re: naming — i'll be "ana" here.
ana: Finance: major question is unit economics — propose we convert at 90% face value and amortize. Will model scenarios.
jess: From SEs: this would help adoption a lot. Suggest bundling 3 months of reserved capacity for 1:1 conversion + an onboarding SI credit. Field enablement doc required.
ben: Legal: private offer T&Cs can be strict. We need no double-dipping, define expiry window, and confirm we can issue credits that count against committed spend. I'll draft a clause.
maria: @ben can you flag any marketplace partner restrictions? Also ops: what does the "exchange" look like programmatically?
suresh: Ops take: flow should be redeem -> verify via marketplace API -> issue dedicated voucher applied to Redwood account. Must emit an auditable event and idempotent operations.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4621 for `marketplace-credit-exchange` prototype :white_check_mark:
nana: Economics proposal sketch: convert 100% marketplace net to reserved at 90% face value, amortize over 12 months. Example mapping:
```json
{
  "marketplace_amount_usd": 10000,
  "conversion_rate": 0.9,
  "redwood_reserved_credit_usd": 9000,
  "amortization_months": 12,
  "monthly_recognized": 750
}
```
jess: Questions from field: restrict to new customers? restrict to first renewal? also need to ensure credits don't extend contract term unintentionally.
maria: Field asks also want a one-click co-commit option in Console during private-offer acceptance. Can be opt-in. Plan a canary with 2 SI partners.
suresh: Technical: SKU alignment is crucial — marketplace SKU -> reserved SKU mapping table required. Also watch rate limits on marketplace verification APIs.
ben: I'll circulate a legal redline by EOD. Also confirm whether this triggers revenue recognition complexity.
nana: Finance: it will. Need to sync with accounting — i'll book 30m with @felix (acctg) tomorrow.
maria: Next steps: 1) Ben legal redline, 2) Ops ticket INF-4621 prototype, 3) SE enablement draft (jess), 4) Finance model (ana). Can we get these by Tue?
jess: :thumbsup: SE will start the draft and pair with SI partner.
suresh: I'll prepare SKU mapping template and attach in INF-4621. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4621
maria: Thanks all — unless anyone objects I'll brief GTM on Fri and propose a 8-week pilot with two partners.
note: thread contains short, informal coordination messages. Messages are in chronological order and prefixed with sender names as required.
